title: Migrate Cyclotron marketing site (Cyclotron-web): standard header/footer and Markus prose

comments.author: home
comments.text: Migrated and live. Approach: full migration to a standard Papyrus site (web/projection.json, web/hooks.py, Markdown content, React islands rendered to HTML at build time and hydrated). Core: AnthusAI/Papyrus#443 (urls.style clean, islands.prerender, div wordmark), released in papyrus-newsroom 5.6.0, pinned. Site PR AnthusAI/Cyclotron-web#143 (merged to develop; local npm run ci passed: 255 site tests, infra, editorial, hooks), promoted via #144 to main; cyclotron-marketing pipeline execution 4162270d (account 682849160744, profile cyclotron-production, asserted) Succeeded. Parity vs live crawl, 32 URLs: all 200, main text identical on 31 (one whitespace-only), links identical, head identical except allow-listed (guide og:type article, article og/twitter title carries site name, added feeds/sitemap/llms/md twins/image size). Visual 1440/390: page bodies and header 0.00% differing pixels on 23 of 30 compared pages, max 0.69% (anti-aliasing) on use-case pages; footer is the Papyrus family footer by design; /editorial-evaluation gains header and footer (live page had none). Live verified after deploy: all 32 URLs, sitemap.xml (32 URLs), robots.txt, llms.txt, feeds, md twins, 404, no console errors, screenshots match pre-migration.
